title: Grokipedia stretches the US political spectrum
abstract: arXiv:2611.32420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models now write reference works that people and other AI systems consult. Grokipedia, written by xAI's model, presents itself as a less biased alternative to crowd-edited Wikipedia. We compare the biographies of 1,614 Democratic and Republican current and former politicians, from Andrew Jackson to members of the current Congress, on both encyclopedias in February and November 2026. For nine in ten Republicans, Grokipedia's biography reads as if written by a more conservative author than Wikipedia's. For Democrats, this holds only about half the time. We find the politicians' ideology explains this asymmetry. For 1,022 politicians with Congressional roll call voting records, how conservative the author seems rises linearly with the politician's ideology and about twice as steeply on Grokipedia as on Wikipedia. translated_title: Grokipedia 拉伸了美国政治光谱
translated_abstract: 语言模型撰写的参考工具书如今会被人类和其他AI系统查阅。由xAI的模型撰写的Grokipedia将自己标榜为众包编辑的维基百科之外一个偏见更少的替代选择。我们在2026年2月和11月比较了两部百科全书中1,614位民主党和共和党现任及前任政治人物（从安德鲁·杰克逊到现任国会议员）的传记。对于十分之九的共和党人，Grokipedia的传记读起来像是出自比维基百科版本更保守的作者之手；而对民主党人，这一情况只在大约一半的时候成立。我们发现政治人物自身的意识形态可以解释这种不对称性：在拥有国会唱名表决记录的1,022位政治人物中，作者的“保守程度”随政治人物意识形态线性上升，且在Grokipedia上的斜率约为维基百科的两倍。在埃隆·马斯克的America PAC投入资金的竞选中，共和党人并未表现出额外的偏见。Grokipedia并非偏袒某个政党，而是……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现，xAI的Grokipedia并非偏袒某一政党，而是系统性“拉伸”了美国政治光谱：对约九成共和党政治人物，其传记读起来比维基百科的更保守，且作者的保守程度随政治人物意识形态线性增强，斜率约为维基百科的两倍。
en_tdlr: Grokipedia does not favor one party but stretches the US political spectrum: for about nine in ten Republican politicians its biographies read as more conservative than Wikipedia's, and the perceived conservatism of the author rises linearly with politicians' ideology at roughly twice the slope of Wikipedia.
